gene_identifier_source: map each formal matrix row from frozen input var_names to frozen input var['gene_symbol']; fall back to var_names only when gene_symbol is missing/blank; then canonicalize

duplicate_gene_rule.gene_spectra: sum within canonical symbol before shared-universe normalization
duplicate_gene_rule.top_genes: rank canonical symbols once using collapsed mean score

representations.spearman: full-gene refit score vectors restricted to pairwise shared canonical-gene universe
representations.cosine: nonnegative full-gene spectra restricted to shared universe, L1-normalized per program and then cosine/L2 dot product
representations.top_gene_overlap: top 50 collapsed score-ranked genes within the shared universe; top 100 saved as fixed sensitivity

composite_similarity: equal-weight mean of max(Spearman rho,0), cosine similarity, and top50 overlap coefficient (overlap/50)
null: for each replicate apply one random gene-identity permutation to all programs on the second side, preserving score/spectra distributions, program relationships, and gene-universe size
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg separately within each pairwise analysis and metric family
robust_primary_match: reciprocal best hit by composite; composite permutation FDR <0.05; at least 2 of 3 independent metrics significant; no B1 TECHNICAL_FLAG on either member

tier_rule.TIER_1_CORE_RECURRENT_PROGRAM: robust primary match and neither member is STRONG_PATIENT_DOMINANCE
tier_rule.TIER_2_DOMINANCE_CAUTIOUS_RECURRENT_PROG: robust primary match and at least one member is STRONG_PATIENT_DOMINANCE

potential_split_merge_rule: statistically supported non-RBH edge with >=2 significant metrics, composite FDR <0.05, no technical flag, and composite >=85% of the best composite for both endpoints; flag only, do not merge
supportive_candidate_representation: on the three-way shared gene universe, average the two primary members' percentile score ranks; average their separately L1-normalized spectra and renormalize; rank top genes from the averaged score representation
supportive_match_rule: candidate-to-GSE196756 reciprocal best by composite; composite permutation FDR <0.05; >=2 significant metrics; no B1 TECHNICAL_FLAG; patient dominance retained as evidence caution
rmp_id_rule: assign RMP_C01... to robust primary RBHs in descending composite similarity; no biological naming
secondary_k_rule: recommend targeted secondary-K sensitivity only if at least one POTENTIAL_SPLIT_MERGE edge is found; do not run it in Phase C
